在 MOSFET 课程结束时，你应该能够：

◻ ◻ ◻\square 描述 n n nn 型和 p 型 MOSFET 的结构。

◻ ◻ ◻\square 解释 MOSFET 的工作原理概念。

◻ ◻ ◻\square 推导一个简单的 MOSFET 解析模型，将电流-电压特性、跨导等与 MOSFET 的结构参数联系起来。

◻ ◻ ◻\square 进行简单 MOSFET 电路的分析。

Reading assignment  阅读作业

◻ ◻ ◻\square D A Neamen, Semiconductor Physics and Devices, Third Edition, McGraw-Hill (2003), pp. 483 - 490, 496 - 501, 524-533.
◻ ◻ ◻\square D A Neamen，《半导体物理与器件》，第三版，麦格劳-希尔出版社（2003 年），第 483-490 页，第 496-501 页，第 524-533 页。

1. Introduction  1. 引言

  • In an n-channel MOSFET, the substrate is p-type, while heavily doped n-type regions form the “source” and “drain” regions.
    在 n 沟道 MOSFET 中，衬底为 p 型，而重掺杂的 n 型区域形成“源极”和“漏极”区域。
    ◻ ◻ ◻\square The electrode on top of the thin oxide (dielectric) layer is called the “gate”.
    ◻ ◻ ◻\square 位于薄氧化层（介电层）顶部的电极称为“栅极”。
  • The source terminal is the source of the carriers that will flow through the channel to the drain terminal.
    源极端子是载流子流经通道到达漏极端子的来源。
  • In this n-channel device, electrons flow from the source to the drain.
    在这个 n 沟道器件中，电子从源极流向漏极。
Conventional current therefore enters from the drain terminal and flows out of the source terminal.
因此，传统电流从漏极端子进入，流出源极端子。
  • Note that usually there is also a contact to the substrate of “body” of the MOSFET, and it is usually grounded.
    注意，通常 MOSFET 的衬底“体”也有一个接触点，且通常接地。
  • In the above MOSFET, when no voltage is applied to the gate ( V G S = 0 V G S = 0 V_(GS)=0V_{G S}=0 ), there is no inversion channel in the silicon under the gate. The source and drain regions are not connected electrically, and no current flows from the drain to the source, even if a voltage is applied between the drain and the source.
    在上述 MOSFET 中，当栅极（ V G S = 0 V G S = 0 V_(GS)=0V_{G S}=0 ）未施加电压时，栅极下的硅中不存在反型通道。源极和漏极区域在电气上不相连，即使在漏极和源极之间施加电压，也不会有电流流动。
    ◻ ◻ ◻\square If a positive voltage that is greater than the threshold is applied at the gate (where V G S > V T V G S > V T V_(GS) > V_(T)V_{G S}>V_{T} ), the vertical electric field through thin gate dielectric causes the formation of an inversion layer at the silicon surface beneath the gate.
    ◻ ◻ ◻\square 如果在栅极施加了大于阈值的正电压（即 V G S > V T V G S > V T V_(GS) > V_(T)V_{G S}>V_{T} ），通过薄栅介电层的垂直电场会在栅极下的硅表面形成反型层。
    => the source and the drain are connected through the inversion layer, and a current can flow between the source and the drain if a bias ( V D S ) V D S (V_(DS))\left(V_{D S}\right) is applied between the drain and the source.
    => 源极和漏极通过反型层连接起来，如果在漏极和源极之间施加偏置 ( V D S ) V D S (V_(DS))\left(V_{D S}\right) ，则电流可以在源极和漏极之间流动。
    ◻ ◻ ◻\square The MOSFET is called an enhancement-mode MOSFET because it is normally off. A conduction channel is formed and a current can flow between the drain and the source only when a gate voltage (greater than the threshold voltage) is applied.
    ◻ ◻ ◻\square 该 MOSFET 被称为增强型 MOSFET，因为它通常处于关闭状态。只有当施加大于阈值电压的栅极电压时，才会形成导电通道，电流才能在漏极和源极之间流动。
    ◻ ◻ ◻\square The principle of operation of the MOSFET can be understood approximately in terms of a water analogy, as shown by the animation below.
    ◻ ◻ ◻\square MOSFET 的工作原理可以通过一个水流类比大致理解，如下方动画所示。
WaterFET animation  WaterFET 动画
  • The above figure shows a depletion-mode MOSFET. When zero voltage is applied to the gate, an inversion layer already exists in the silicon under the gate. This acts as a channel connecting the source and the drain. A current will flow if a voltage is applied between the drain and the source.
    上图显示的是一个耗尽型 MOSFET。当栅极电压为零时，栅极下的硅中已经存在一个反型层。这个反型层作为连接源极和漏极的通道。如果在漏极和源极之间施加电压，电流就会流动。
  • To remove the inversion layer, and hence to stop the current flow, a negative voltage has to be applied to the gate. Note that the threshold voltage is negative (even though the device has a p-type substrate.)
    为了去除反型层，从而停止电流流动，必须在栅极施加负电压。请注意，阈值电压是负的（尽管该器件具有 P 型衬底）。
  • Since most of the MOSFETs in both analog and digital circuit are enhancement-mode devices, it is assumed that all the MOSFETs discussed in this course are enhancement mode MOSFETs unless otherwise specified.
    由于大多数模拟和数字电路中的 MOSFET 都是增强型器件，因此除非另有说明，本课程中讨论的所有 MOSFET 均假定为增强型 MOSFET。
    regions. The substrate is n-type.
    区域。衬底为 n 型。
    ◻ ◻ ◻\square When a negative voltage whose magnitude is greater than the threshold voltage (which is also negative) is applied to gate, an inversion layer of holes is formed. Holes flow from the source to the drain when a voltage V D S V D S V_(DS)V_{D S} is applied.
    ◻ ◻ ◻\square 当施加一个幅值大于阈值电压（该阈值电压也是负的）的负电压到栅极时，会形成一个空穴反转层。当施加电压 V D S V D S V_(DS)V_{D S} 时，空穴从源极流向漏极。

2. I-V relationship: Conceptual Approach
2. 电流-电压关系：概念性方法

Consider an n-channel enhancement mode MOSFET
考虑一个 n 沟道增强型 MOSFET

(i) Cut-off or subthreshold region
（一）截止区或亚阈值区
  • V G S V G S V_(GS)V_{G S} is zero or less than V T V T V_(T)V_{T}, and V D S V D S V_(DS)V_{D S} is a small positive voltage.
    V G S V G S V_(GS)V_{G S} 小于或等于 V T V T V_(T)V_{T} ，且 V D S V D S V_(DS)V_{D S} 是一个小的正电压。
    ◻ ◻ ◻\square In this situation, no electron inversion layer is formed and the drain junction is reverse biased, therefore the drain current is ideally zero.
    ◻ ◻ ◻\square 在这种情况下，不会形成电子反转层，且漏极结反向偏置，因此漏极电流理想情况下为零。

(ii) Linear region  （ii）线性区


◻ ◻ ◻\square When V G S > V T V G S > V T V_(GS) > V_(T)V_{G S}>V_{T}, an electron inversion layer is formed in the silicon under the gate, and forms a conducting channel between the source and the drain.
◻ ◻ ◻\square 当 V G S > V T V G S > V T V_(GS) > V_(T)V_{G S}>V_{T} 时，在栅极下的硅中形成电子反型层，并在源极和漏极之间形成导电通道。
◻ ◻ ◻\square Underneath the inversion channel, there is a thick depletion region.
◻ ◻ ◻\square 在反型通道下方，有一个厚的耗尽区。
◻ ◻ ◻\square For small V D S V D S V_(DS)V_{D S}, the channel thickness is approximately constant and has the characteristics of a resistor (or conductor). Therefore, the change in the drain current, Δ I D Δ I D DeltaI_(D)\Delta I_{D}, is proportional to the change in the drain voltage Δ V D S Δ V D S DeltaV_(DS)\Delta V_{D S}, i.e.,
◻ ◻ ◻\square 对于小的 V D S V D S V_(DS)V_{D S} ，通道厚度近似恒定，具有电阻（或导体）的特性。因此，漏极电流的变化 Δ I D Δ I D DeltaI_(D)\Delta I_{D} 与漏极电压的变化 Δ V D S Δ V D S DeltaV_(DS)\Delta V_{D S} 成正比，即，
Δ I D = g d Δ V D S Δ I D = g d Δ V D S DeltaI_(D)=g_(d)DeltaV_(DS)\Delta I_{D}=g_{d} \Delta V_{D S}
where g d g d g_(d)g_{d} is the conductance of the channel.
其中 g d g d g_(d)g_{d} 是通道的电导。
◻ ◻ ◻\square When the gate bias V G S V G S V_(GS)V_{G S} is increased, more charges are deposited on the gate, which in turn induce more electrons in the inversion layer.
◻ ◻ ◻\square 当栅极偏压 V G S V G S V_(GS)V_{G S} 增加时，更多的电荷被沉积在栅极上，进而在反型层中诱导出更多的电子。
◻ ◻ ◻\square The channel conductance g d g d g_(d)g_{d} depends on the amount of inversion layer charge, and the inversion layer charge is a function of V G S V G S V_(GS)V_{G S}.
◻ ◻ ◻\square 通道电导 g d g d g_(d)g_{d} 取决于反型层电荷的数量，而反型层电荷是 V G S V G S V_(GS)V_{G S} 的函数。
◻ ◻ ◻\square This therefore results in the modulation of the channel conductance, which determines I D I D I_(D)I_{D}, by V G S V G S V_(GS)V_{G S}.
◻ ◻ ◻\square 因此，这导致了通道电导的调制，通道电导由 V G S V G S V_(GS)V_{G S} 决定 I D I D I_(D)I_{D} 。

(iii) Saturation region  （三）饱和区

  • As V D S V D S V_(DS)V_{D S} is increased, there is a significant voltage drop along the channel from the drain to the source. As a result, the voltage drop across the oxide, between the gate and the channel near the drain junction edge decreases.
    随着 V D S V D S V_(DS)V_{D S} 的增加，沿着从漏极到源极的通道会出现显著的电压降。因此，靠近漏极结边缘的栅极与通道之间的氧化层电压降减小。
    → → rarr\rightarrow The inversion charge density near the drain decreases and the channel tapers towards the drain end.
    → → rarr\rightarrow 靠近漏极的反型电荷密度减少，通道在漏极端逐渐变窄。
  • The incremental conductance of the channel decreases as V D S V D S V_(DS)V_{D S} gets larger.
    随着 V D S V D S V_(DS)V_{D S} 变大，通道的增量电导减小。
    ◻ Δ I D ◻ Δ I D ◻DeltaI_(D)\square \Delta I_{D} increases at a slower rate with Δ V D S Δ V D S DeltaV_(DS)\Delta V_{D S}.
    ◻ Δ I D ◻ Δ I D ◻DeltaI_(D)\square \Delta I_{D} 随着 Δ V D S Δ V D S DeltaV_(DS)\Delta V_{D S} 的增加，增长速度变慢。

    ◻ ◻ ◻\square When V D S V D S V_(DS)V_{D S} increases further to the point where the voltage drop across the oxide, between the gate and the channel at the drain edge, is equal to the threshold voltage V T V T V_(T)V_{T}, the inversion charge density is zero at the drain edge.
    ◻ ◻ ◻\square 当 V D S V D S V_(DS)V_{D S} 进一步增加到使得氧化层上，栅极与漏极边缘通道之间的电压降等于阈值电压 V T V T V_(T)V_{T} 时，漏极边缘的反转电荷密度为零。
    ◻ ◻ ◻\square This is called the “pinch-off” condition. The inversion layer is pinched-off at the drain edge.
    ◻ ◻ ◻\square 这称为“夹断”状态。反转层在漏极边缘被夹断。
    ◻ ◻ ◻\square At the point of pinch-off, the incremental conductance is zero.
    ◻ ◻ ◻\square 在夹断点，增量电导为零。
    → → rarr\rightarrow the slope of I D I D I_(D)I_{D} vs. V D S V D S V_(DS)V_{D S} curve becomes zero for this condition.
    → → rarr\rightarrow 在这种条件下， I D I D I_(D)I_{D} 对 V D S V D S V_(DS)V_{D S} 曲线的斜率变为零。
    ◻ ◻ ◻\square There is no more increase in I D I D I_(D)I_{D} with the increase of V D S ⇒ V D S ⇒ V_(DS)=>V_{D S} \Rightarrow The drain current is said to be “saturated”.
    ◻ ◻ ◻\square 随着 V D S ⇒ V D S ⇒ V_(DS)=>V_{D S} \Rightarrow 的增加， I D I D I_(D)I_{D} 不再增加。漏极电流被称为“饱和”。
    ◻ ◻ ◻\square We define " V D S ( s a t ) V D S ( s a t ) V_(DS)(sat)V_{D S}(s a t) " as the drain voltage which produces pinch-off condition at the drain junction edge, i.e., V G S − V D S ( s a t ) = V T V G S − V D S ( s a t ) = V T V_(GS)-V_(DS)(sat)=V_(T)V_{G S}-V_{D S}(s a t)=V_{T}, or
    ◻ ◻ ◻\square 我们定义“ V D S ( s a t ) V D S ( s a t ) V_(DS)(sat)V_{D S}(s a t) ”为在漏极结边缘产生掐断条件的漏极电压，即 V G S − V D S ( s a t ) = V T V G S − V D S ( s a t ) = V T V_(GS)-V_(DS)(sat)=V_(T)V_{G S}-V_{D S}(s a t)=V_{T} ，或者
V D S ( s a t ) = V G S − V T V D S ( s a t ) = V G S − V T V_(DS)(sat)=V_(GS)-V_(T)V_{D S}(s a t)=V_{G S}-V_{T}
  • When V D > V D S ( V D > V D S ( V_(D) > V_(DS)(V_{D}>V_{D S}( sat ) ) )), the pinch-off point in the channel moves toward the source junction edge.
    当 V D > V D S ( V D > V D S ( V_(D) > V_(DS)(V_{D}>V_{D S}( 饱和 ) ) )) 时，通道中的掐断点向源结边缘移动。
    ◻ ◻ ◻\square Electrons enter the channel at the source and travel (by drift) through the channel towards the drain. When they reach the pinch-off point, the electrons are injected into the depletion region where they are swept by the E-field into the drain.
    ◻ ◻ ◻\square 电子从源极进入通道，通过漂移方式沿通道向漏极移动。当它们到达夹断点时，电子被注入耗尽区，在电场作用下被扫入漏极。
  • For a given MOSFET and at a given V G S , V D S ( s a t ) V G S , V D S ( s a t ) V_(GS),V_(DS)(sat)V_{G S}, V_{D S}(s a t) is constant, as given by eqn (2.2).
    对于给定的 MOSFET，在给定的 V G S , V D S ( s a t ) V G S , V D S ( s a t ) V_(GS),V_(DS)(sat)V_{G S}, V_{D S}(s a t) 下，电流是恒定的，如方程(2.2)所示。
    ◻ ◻ ◻\square If the change in the channel length ( Δ L Δ L Delta L\Delta L ) due to the movement of the pinch-off point is small compared to the original channel length ( L L LL ), then the resistance of the inversion channel is approximately constant. As the drain current I D I D I_(D)I_{D} is a function of the voltage drop in the channel (= V D S ( s a t ) ) V D S ( s a t ) {:V_(DS)(sat))\left.V_{D S}(s a t)\right) and the channel resistance, I D I D I_(D)I_{D} would therefore be constant for drain voltages V D > V D S V D > V D S V_(D) > V_(DS)V_{D}>V_{D S} (sat).
    ◻ ◻ ◻\square 如果由于夹断点移动引起的通道长度变化（ Δ L Δ L Delta L\Delta L ）相对于原始通道长度（ L L LL ）较小，则反型通道的电阻近似为常数。由于漏极电流 I D I D I_(D)I_{D} 是通道电压降（= V D S ( s a t ) ) V D S ( s a t ) {:V_(DS)(sat))\left.V_{D S}(s a t)\right) ）和通道电阻的函数，因此对于漏极电压 V D > V D S V D > V D S V_(D) > V_(DS)V_{D}>V_{D S} （饱和区）， I D I D I_(D)I_{D} 将保持不变。
  • We have noted earlier that the inversion channel charge is a function of the gate bias V G S ( V G S V_(GS)(:}V_{G S}\left(\right. for V G S > V T ) V G S > V T {:V_(GS) > V_(T))\left.V_{G S}>V_{T}\right). By changing V G S V G S V_(GS)V_{G S}, we modulate the channel resistance (or conductance).
    我们之前已经注意到，反型通道电荷是栅极偏压 V G S ( V G S V_(GS)(:}V_{G S}\left(\right. 的函数，适用于 V G S > V T ) V G S > V T {:V_(GS) > V_(T))\left.V_{G S}>V_{T}\right) 。通过改变 V G S V G S V_(GS)V_{G S} ，我们调制通道电阻（或电导）。
    ◻ ◻ ◻\square Therefore, each time when V G S V G S V_(GS)V_{G S} is changed, we get a different I D − V D S I D − V D S I_(D)-V_(DS)I_{D}-V_{D S} characteristic. By varying V G S V G S V_(GS)V_{G S}, we can generate a family of curves for the nchannel enhancement-mode MOSFET, as shown in the figure below.
    ◻ ◻ ◻\square 因此，每当 V G S V G S V_(GS)V_{G S} 发生变化时，我们会得到不同的 I D − V D S I D − V D S I_(D)-V_(DS)I_{D}-V_{D S} 特性。通过改变 V G S V G S V_(GS)V_{G S} ，我们可以生成一组 n 沟道增强型 MOSFET 的曲线族，如下图所示。
MOSFET Simulation applet
MOSFET 仿真小程序

P-channel (enhancement mode) MOSFET
P 沟道（增强型）MOSFET

◻ ◻ ◻\square In a p-channel MOSFET, V D S , V G S V D S , V G S V_(DS),V_(GS)V_{D S}, V_{G S} and V T V T V_(T)V_{T} are all negative.
◻ ◻ ◻\square 在 p 沟道 MOSFET 中， V D S , V G S V D S , V G S V_(DS),V_(GS)V_{D S}, V_{G S} 和 V T V T V_(T)V_{T} 都是负值。
◻ ◻ ◻\square Holes are the majority carriers. They flow from source to drain.
◻ ◻ ◻\square 空穴是多数载流子。它们从源极流向漏极。
→ → rarr\rightarrow therefore I D I D I_(D)I_{D} is also negative (with the direction as defined in the figure).
→ → rarr\rightarrow 因此 I D I D I_(D)I_{D} 也是负的（按照图中定义的方向）。

3. I-V relationship: Analytical Approach
3. 电流-电压关系：解析方法

Assumptions :  假设：

  1. The current in the channel is due to drift and not diffusion.
    通道中的电流是由漂移引起的，而不是扩散。
  2. There is no current flowing through the oxide
    氧化层中没有电流流动。
  3. The electric field along the channel (in the x x xx-direction) is constant - gradual channel approximation.
    沿通道的电场（在 x x xx 方向）是恒定的——渐进通道近似。
  4. The carrier mobility in the channel is constant.
    通道中的载流子迁移率是恒定的。
  5. There are no charges in the oxide.*
    氧化层中没有电荷。*
  • This assumption is not really necessary. We assume it here so as not to complicate our derivation. We can deal with it as what we have done in the derivation of the threshold voltage
    这个假设其实并非绝对必要。我们在这里假设它，是为了不使推导过程复杂化。我们可以像在阈值电压的推导中那样处理它。
    ◻ ◻ ◻\square The drain current I D I D I_(D)I_{D} is the rate of movement of the charges that flow along the inversion channel from the source to the drain. It is related to the channel charge density Q n Q n Q_(n)Q_{n} and the charge transit time t T R t T R t_(TR)t_{T R} through the equation
    ◻ ◻ ◻\square 漏极电流 I D I D I_(D)I_{D} 是沿着反型层通道从源极流向漏极的电荷移动速率。它与通道电荷密度 Q n Q n Q_(n)Q_{n} 和电荷传输时间 t T R t T R t_(TR)t_{T R} 通过以下方程相关联。
I D = − Q n W L t T R I D = − Q n W L t T R I_(D)=-(Q_(n)WL)/(t_(TR))I_{D}=-\frac{Q_{n} W L}{t_{T R}}
◻ ◻ ◻\square The charge transit time t T R t T R t_(TR)t_{T R} is the time it takes for the charges in the channel inversion layer to travel from the source to the drain. Because current flow in the channel is by drift, t T R t T R t_(TR)t_{T R} is just the channel length L L LL divided by the drift velocity v d v d v_(d)v_{d}.
◻ ◻ ◻\square 电荷传输时间 t T R t T R t_(TR)t_{T R} 是通道反型层中的电荷从源极移动到漏极所需的时间。由于通道中的电流是漂移电流， t T R t T R t_(TR)t_{T R} 仅仅是通道长度 L L LL 除以漂移速度 v d v d v_(d)v_{d} 。
t T R = L v d v d = − μ n ξ = μ n V D S L t T R = L v d v d = − μ n ξ = μ n V D S L {:[t_(TR)=(L)/(v_(d))],[v_(d)=-mu_(n)xi=mu_(n)(V_(DS))/(L)]:}\begin{aligned} t_{T R} & =\frac{L}{v_{d}} \\ v_{d} & =-\mu_{n} \xi=\mu_{n} \frac{V_{D S}}{L} \end{aligned}
Drift velocity  漂移速度
where ξ ξ xi\xi is the channel lateral electric field (i.e., electric field in the x x xx-direction).
其中 ξ ξ xi\xi 是沟道横向电场（即 x x xx 方向的电场）。

g m = μ n W L C O X V D S g m = μ n W L C O X V D S g_(m)=mu_(n)(W)/(L)C_(OX)V_(DS)g_{m}=\mu_{n} \frac{W}{L} C_{O X} V_{D S}

However, the real, experimental plot as shown in the previous figure indicates otherwise.

◻ ◻ ◻\square Usually, the point of maximum slope of the I D − V G S I D − V G S I_(D)-V_(GS)I_{D}-V_{G S} curve (or maximum g m g m g_(m)g_{m} ) lies at about 0.5 V above V T V T V_(T)V_{T}.

◻ ◻ ◻\square It is the usual practice to measure V T V T V_(T)V_{T} by extrapolation of a straight line which is a tangent to the I D − V G S I D − V G S I_(D)-V_(GS)I_{D}-V_{G S} curve at the point of maximum g m g m g_(m)g_{m}.

◻ ◻ ◻\square The transconductance of the MOSFET,
◻ ◻ ◻\square MOSFET 的跨导，
g m = μ n W L C O X V D S g m = μ n W L C O X V D S g_(m)=mu_(n)(W)/(L)C_(OX)V_(DS)g_{m}=\mu_{n} \frac{W}{L} C_{O X} V_{D S}
◻ gm ◻ gm ◻gm\square \mathrm{gm} is a measure of the transistor gain of the MOSFET.
◻ gm ◻ gm ◻gm\square \mathrm{gm} 是 MOSFET 晶体管增益的一个度量。
◻ ◻ ◻\square The device parameters which decide g m g m g_(m)g_{m} are W , L , μ n , C O X W , L , μ n , C O X W,L,mu_(n),C_(OX)W, L, \mu_{n}, C_{O X}.
◻ ◻ ◻\square 决定 g m g m g_(m)g_{m} 的器件参数是 W , L , μ n , C O X W , L , μ n , C O X W,L,mu_(n),C_(OX)W, L, \mu_{n}, C_{O X} 。
◻ ◻ ◻\square Therefore, to achieve high g m g m g_(m)g_{m}
◻ ◻ ◻\square 因此，为了实现高 g m g m g_(m)g_{m}
→ → rarr\rightarrow transistor channel width, W, must be large,
→ → rarr\rightarrow 晶体管通道宽度 W 必须较大，
→ → rarr\rightarrow transistor channel length, L, must be small,
→ → rarr\rightarrow 晶体管通道长度 L 必须较小，

→ → rarr\rightarrow 通道载流子迁移率， μ n μ n mu_(n)\mu_{n} ，必须高，
→ → rarr\rightarrow gate oxide thickness, t O X t O X t_(OX)t_{O X}, must be thin ( to maintain high C O X C O X C_(OX)C_{O X} ).
→ → rarr\rightarrow 栅氧厚度， t O X t O X t_(OX)t_{O X} ，必须薄（以保持高 C O X C O X C_(OX)C_{O X} ）。

5. Second Order Effects
5. 二阶效应

5.1 Substrate Bias effect
5.1 衬底偏压效应

◻ ◻ ◻\square In an n-channel MOSFET, the p-type substrate must be reverse biased with respect to the source (which is at zero bias). Otherwise, the source/drain junctions will become forward biased with respect to the p-type substrate, resulting in a huge current flow from the substrate to the source/drain. There will be no transistor action.
◻ ◻ ◻\square 在 n 沟道 MOSFET 中，p 型衬底必须相对于源极（源极为零偏置）施加反向偏置。否则，源/漏结相对于 p 型衬底将变为正向偏置，导致从衬底到源/漏的大电流流动。这样将无法实现晶体管的作用。
◻ ◻ ◻\square When a reverse bias between the source and the substrate is applied ( V B S < 0 V B S < 0 V_(BS) < 0V_{B S}<0, or V S B > 0 V S B > 0 V_(SB) > 0V_{S B}>0 ), the depletion region width under the gate oxide increases. The depletion region width of the source/drain junction also increases, as the source/drain junctions are more strongly negatively biased.
◻ ◻ ◻\square 当源极与衬底之间施加反向偏置（ V B S < 0 V B S < 0 V_(BS) < 0V_{B S}<0 ，或 V S B > 0 V S B > 0 V_(SB) > 0V_{S B}>0 ）时，栅氧化层下的耗尽区宽度增加。由于源/漏结受到更强的负偏置，源/漏结的耗尽区宽度也会增加。
◻ ◻ ◻\square As there are more negative charges (due to ionised acceptors) in the channel, more positive charges have to be applied to the gate before inversion can occur.
◻ ◻ ◻\square 由于通道中存在更多的负电荷（由电离受主产生），必须在栅极施加更多的正电荷才能发生反转。

◻ ◻ ◻\square For the ideal MOSFET, the threshold voltage can be expressed as
◻ ◻ ◻\square 对于理想的 MOSFET，阈值电压可以表示为
V T = − Q D C o x + 2 ϕ b = 2 e ε N A ϕ b C o x + 2 ϕ b V T = − Q D C o x + 2 ϕ b = 2 e ε N A ϕ b C o x + 2 ϕ b V_(T)=-(Q_(D))/(C_(ox))+2phi_(b)=(2sqrt(e epsiN_(A)phi_(b)))/(C_(ox))+2phi_(b)V_{T}=-\frac{Q_{D}}{C_{o x}}+2 \phi_{b}=\frac{2 \sqrt{e \varepsilon N_{A} \phi_{b}}}{C_{o x}}+2 \phi_{b}
where the depletion region charge, Q D Q D Q_(D)Q_{D}, is given by
耗尽区电荷， Q D Q D Q_(D)Q_{D} ，由下式给出
Q D = − e N A x d T = − 2 e ε N A ϕ s Q D = − e N A x d T = − 2 e ε N A ϕ s Q_(D)=-eN_(A)x_(dT)=-sqrt(2e epsiN_(A)phi_(s))Q_{D}=-e N_{A} x_{d T}=-\sqrt{2 e \varepsilon N_{A} \phi_{s}}

◻ ◻ ◻\square When a substrate bias V S B V S B V_(SB)V_{S B} is applied, there is an additional potential between the substrate and the channel. The surface potential Φ s Φ s Phi_(s)\Phi_{s} is increased by V S B V S B V_(SB)V_{S B}.
◻ ◻ ◻\square 当施加基底偏压 V S B V S B V_(SB)V_{S B} 时，基底与沟道之间存在额外的电势。表面电势 Φ s Φ s Phi_(s)\Phi_{s} 增加了 V S B V S B V_(SB)V_{S B} 。
◻ ◻ ◻\square With the application of a substrate bias V S B V S B V_(SB)V_{S B}, at the onset of strong inversion, the surface potential is
◻ ◻ ◻\square 施加基底偏压 V S B V S B V_(SB)V_{S B} 时，在强反转开始时，表面电势为
ϕ s = 2 ϕ b + V S B ϕ s = 2 ϕ b + V S B phi_(s)=2phi_(b)+V_(SB)\phi_{s}=2 \phi_{b}+V_{S B}
◻ ◻ ◻\square The depletion region charge is then given by
◻ ◻ ◻\square 耗尽区电荷由下式给出
Q D ( V S B ) = − 2 e ε N A ( 2 ϕ b + V S B ) Q D V S B = − 2 e ε N A 2 ϕ b + V S B Q_(D)(V_(SB))=-sqrt(2e epsiN_(A)(2phi_(b)+V_(SB)))Q_{D}\left(V_{S B}\right)=-\sqrt{2 e \varepsilon N_{A}\left(2 \phi_{b}+V_{S B}\right)}
◻ ◻ ◻\square The change in the depletion region charge when a substrate bias V S B V S B V_(SB)V_{S B} is applied,
◻ ◻ ◻\square 当施加基底偏压 V S B V S B V_(SB)V_{S B} 时，耗尽区电荷的变化，
Δ Q D ( V S B ) = − 2 e ε N A ( 2 ϕ b + V S B − 2 ϕ b ) Δ Q D V S B = − 2 e ε N A 2 ϕ b + V S B − 2 ϕ b DeltaQ_(D)(V_(SB))=-sqrt(2e epsiN_(A))(sqrt(2phi_(b)+V_(SB))-sqrt(2phi_(b)))\Delta Q_{D}\left(V_{S B}\right)=-\sqrt{2 e \varepsilon N_{A}}\left(\sqrt{2 \phi_{b}+V_{S B}}-\sqrt{2 \phi_{b}}\right)
◻ ◻ ◻\square The corresponding change in the threshold voltage,
◻ ◻ ◻\square 阈值电压的相应变化，
Δ V T = − Δ Q D C o x = 2 e ε N A C o x ( 2 ϕ b + V S B − 2 ϕ b ) Δ V T = − Δ Q D C o x = 2 e ε N A C o x 2 ϕ b + V S B − 2 ϕ b DeltaV_(T)=-(DeltaQ_(D))/(C_(ox))=(sqrt(2e epsiN_(A)))/(C_(ox))(sqrt(2phi_(b)+V_(SB))-sqrt(2phi_(b)))\Delta V_{T}=-\frac{\Delta Q_{D}}{C_{o x}}=\frac{\sqrt{2 e \varepsilon N_{A}}}{C_{o x}}\left(\sqrt{2 \phi_{b}+V_{S B}}-\sqrt{2 \phi_{b}}\right)

5.2 Subthreshold conduction
5.2 亚阈值导电

◻ ◻ ◻\square The ideal I D − V D S I D − V D S I_(D)-V_(DS)I_{D}-V_{D S} relationship of the MOSFET predicts that I D = 0 I D = 0 I_(D)=0I_{D}=0 for V G S < V T V G S < V T V_(GS) < V_(T)V_{G S}<V_{T}. However, in the actual situation, I D I D I_(D)I_{D} is not zero when V G S < V T V G S < V T V_(GS) < V_(T)V_{G S}<V_{T}.
◻ ◻ ◻\square MOSFET 的理想 I D − V D S I D − V D S I_(D)-V_(DS)I_{D}-V_{D S} 关系预测 I D = 0 I D = 0 I_(D)=0I_{D}=0 在 V G S < V T V G S < V T V_(GS) < V_(T)V_{G S}<V_{T} 时为零。然而，在实际情况下， I D I D I_(D)I_{D} 在 V G S < V T V G S < V T V_(GS) < V_(T)V_{G S}<V_{T} 时不为零。
◻ ◻ ◻\square This is because we assume that an inversion channel is formed only under strong inversion condition, when V G S > V T V G S > V T V_(GS) > V_(T)V_{G S}>V_{T}. Before that, when V G S V G S V_(GS)V_{G S} is slightly less than V T V T V_(T)V_{T}, the MOSFET has entered the weak inversion condition, and there are already some minority carriers (electrons in an n-MOSFET) in the channel.
◻ ◻ ◻\square 这是因为我们假设只有在强反转条件下才形成反转沟道，当 V G S > V T V G S > V T V_(GS) > V_(T)V_{G S}>V_{T} 。在此之前，当 V G S V G S V_(GS)V_{G S} 略小于 V T V T V_(T)V_{T} 时，MOSFET 已进入弱反转状态，沟道中已经存在一些少数载流子（n-MOSFET 中的电子）。
◻ ◻ ◻\square These electrons can conduct a small current I D I D I_(D)I_{D} through the channel when V D S V D S V_(DS)V_{D S} is applied.
◻ ◻ ◻\square 当施加 V D S V D S V_(DS)V_{D S} 时，这些电子可以通过沟道导通一小部分电流 I D I D I_(D)I_{D} 。
◻ ◻ ◻\square The drain current that flows when V G S < V T V G S < V T V_(GS) < V_(T)V_{G S}<V_{T} is known as the “subthreshold current”
◻ ◻ ◻\square 当 V G S < V T V G S < V T V_(GS) < V_(T)V_{G S}<V_{T} 时流过的漏极电流称为“亚阈值电流”。

◻ ◻ ◻\square The subthreshold characteristics of a MOSFET are often evaluated with a parameter “S” properly called “inverse subthreshold slope”, but very often simply called “subthreshold slope”, which is defined as
◻ ◻ ◻\square MOSFET 的亚阈值特性通常用一个参数“S”来评估，正式称为“反亚阈值斜率”，但通常简称为“亚阈值斜率”，其定义为：
S = 1 d ( log 10 ⁡ I D ) d V G S = ln ⁡ ( 10 ) × d V G S d ( ln ⁡ I D ) S = 1 d log 10 ⁡ I D d V G S = ln ⁡ ( 10 ) × d V G S d ln ⁡ I D S=(1)/((d(log_(10)I_(D)))/(dV_(GS)))=ln(10)xx(dV_(GS))/(d(ln I_(D)))S=\frac{1}{\frac{d\left(\log _{10} I_{D}\right)}{d V_{G S}}}=\ln (10) \times \frac{d V_{G S}}{d\left(\ln I_{D}\right)}

◻ ◻ ◻\square Subthreshold currents are undesirable as they add significantly to power dissipation in very large scale integrated circuits consisting of millions of MOSFETs. The circuit design of the IC must take subthreshold currents into account, or ensure that the MOSFET is biased sufficiently below the threshold voltage when it is in the “OFF” state.
◻ ◻ ◻\square 亚阈值电流是不受欢迎的，因为它们在由数百万个 MOSFET 组成的超大规模集成电路中显著增加了功耗。IC 的电路设计必须考虑亚阈值电流，或者确保 MOSFET 在“关闭”状态时偏置电压远低于阈值电压。

5.3 Channel Length Modulation
5.3 通道长度调制

◻ ◻ ◻\square In the derivation of the ideal I − V I − V I-VI-V relationship of the MOSFET, we assumed that the channel length L L LL was constant.
◻ ◻ ◻\square 在 MOSFET 理想 I − V I − V I-VI-V 关系的推导中，我们假设通道长度 L L LL 是恒定的。
◻ ◻ ◻\square However, when V DS > V DS,SAT V DS  > V DS,SAT  V_("DS ") > V_("DS,SAT ")\mathrm{V}_{\text {DS }}>\mathrm{V}_{\text {DS,SAT }}, the depletion region at the drain junction extends laterally into the channel and the pinch-off point moves toward the source. This reduces the effective channel length.
◻ ◻ ◻\square 然而，当 V DS > V DS,SAT V DS  > V DS,SAT  V_("DS ") > V_("DS,SAT ")\mathrm{V}_{\text {DS }}>\mathrm{V}_{\text {DS,SAT }} 时，漏极结处的耗尽区横向延伸到通道中，夹断点向源极移动。这减少了有效通道长度。
◻ ◻ ◻\square The effective channel length, L eff L eff  L_("eff ")L_{\text {eff }} is bias dependent and is modulated by V D S V D S V_(DS)V_{D S}. This is called “channel length modulation”.
◻ ◻ ◻\square 有效沟道长度 L eff L eff  L_("eff ")L_{\text {eff }} 是偏置依赖的，并且受到 V D S V D S V_(DS)V_{D S} 的调制。这称为“沟道长度调制”。
◻ ◻ ◻\square The conductance of the channel is therefore reduced, which leads to an increase in the drain current I D I D I_(D)I_{D}
◻ ◻ ◻\square 因此，沟道的电导减小，导致漏极电流 I D I D I_(D)I_{D} 增加。

◻ ◻ ◻\square Since the drain current is inversely proportional to the channel length
◻ ◻ ◻\square 由于漏极电流与沟道长度成反比，
I D ′ = ( L L − Δ L ) I D = L L e f f I D I D ′ = L L − Δ L I D = L L e f f I D I_(D)^(')=((L)/(L-Delta L))I_(D)=(L)/(L_(eff))I_(D)I_{D}^{\prime}=\left(\frac{L}{L-\Delta L}\right) I_{D}=\frac{L}{L_{e f f}} I_{D}
therefore, the drain current I D I D I_(D)I_{D} increases with drain voltage even after saturation.
因此，漏极电流 I D I D I_(D)I_{D} 即使在饱和后也会随着漏极电压的增加而增加。
◻ ◻ ◻\square For long channel MOSFETs, the change in the channel length, Δ L Δ L Delta L\Delta L, is not significant compared to the original channel length L L LL. The change in the drain current after saturation is therefore not significant.
◻ ◻ ◻\square 对于长沟道 MOSFET，沟道长度的变化， Δ L Δ L Delta L\Delta L ，与原始沟道长度 L L LL 相比并不显著。因此，饱和后漏极电流的变化也不显著。
◻ ◻ ◻\square As the MOSFET channel length becomes shorter, A L A L ALA L becomes a larger fraction of the original channel length L L LL. Hence, the impact of channel length modulation is more obvious in short channel devices.
◻ ◻ ◻\square 随着 MOSFET 沟道长度变短， A L A L ALA L 成为原始沟道长度 L L LL 的更大比例。因此，沟道长度调制的影响在短沟道器件中更为明显。

    *注意：这是最简单且最近似的分析。更准确的分析见 Neamen，第 490-495 页。还有其他更精确的 MOSFET 工作模型，但这些都超出了本模块的范围。

      这些现象将在后续“二阶效应”部分讨论。
